# ex: assigneeType via variadic function argument
ex {
	var x int
	F(x) -> G(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int) int    { return x }
func G(x int) int    { return x + 1 }
func V(xs ...int) {} 

func H() {
	V(F(1), F(2))
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,9 +1,9 @@
 package m

-func F(x int) int    { return x }
-func G(x int) int    { return x + 1 }
-func V(xs ...int) {}
+func F(x int) int { return x }
+func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }
+func V(xs ...int) {}

 func H() {
-	V(F(1), F(2))
+	V(G(1), G(2))
 }
